profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Highly skilled software developer and architect with proven record of delivering software integration solutions across multiple industries and a focus on Financial Services during the past five years. Known for being highly effective at analyzing complex problems and for delivering optimal solutions.  Subject matter expert in the definition of a firm-wide Web Services Infrastructure Architecture for a large investment bank and experience leading a cross-disciplinary and multi-region team in the delivery of a large-scale distributed system.
